document.purpose: Let an on-call engineer rotate the signing key safely
document.text:
# Rotating the API signing key

Do this when the key is older than 90 days or may have leaked.

1. Generate a key: `openssl genpkey -algorithm ed25519 -out new.pem`.
2. Add the public half to `config/keys.json` under `next`. Deploy. Both keys now verify; only the old one signs.
3. After 24 hours (the longest token lifetime), move `next` to `current`. Deploy.
4. Delete the old key from the secret store.

If step 3 goes out early, tokens signed in the last 24 hours fail with 401. Roll back by restoring the old `current`.

document.purpose: Explain a latency regression to the team
document.text:
# Why our p95 doubled on 3 March

The 2.14 release moved session lookup from Redis to Postgres. Session reads went from 0.4 ms to 9 ms, and the checkout page does 11 of them, so p95 rose from 210 ms to 390 ms. Reverting the lookup in 2.14.1 brought it back to 215 ms. The longer fix is to load the session once per request; that is tracked in PAY-412.
